exposure: Elective repeat cesarean delivery at different gestational ages (37 0/7 to 39 6/7 weeks)
Gestational age at delivery (37 0/7 to 38 6/7 weeks, 39 0/7 to 39 6/7 weeks)
cohort: 26,522 women with at least two previous cesarean deliveries
finding: For women with ≥2 previous cesarean deliveries, elective delivery at 38 0/7 to 38 6/7 weeks' gestation appears to be the optimal balance between neonatal and maternal risk while decreasing the likelihood of an unplanned cesarean delivery.
